title: CJP’s Abhijeet Dipke says he spent night at airport on way back from Kochi protest

ai.summary: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke said he spent the night at an airport waiting for a delayed flight after attending a protest against SIR irregularities in Kochi.

facts.claim: CJP's Dipke offered an account of his airport experience, saying he had spent the night there, sleep-deprived, as he waited for a delayed connecting flight.
facts.quote: CJP's Dipke offered an account of his airport experience, saying he had spent the night there, sleep-deprived, as he waited for a delayed connecting flight.

facts.claim: Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke on Sunday said he had to spend the night at the airport as he waited for a delayed connecting flight on his way back from the anti-SIR stir in Kochi.
facts.quote: Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke on Sunday said he had to spend the night at the airport as he waited for a delayed connecting flight on his way back from the anti-SIR stir in Kochi.

facts.claim: Dipke attended the CJP's protest against chief election commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar and alleged SIR irregularities in Kochi on Saturday.
facts.quote: Dipke attended the CJP's protest against chief election commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar and alleged SIR irregularities in Kochi on Saturday.

facts.claim: Dipke was granted conditional bail last month, a day after he was briefly detained and arrested for trying to take out a Tiranga rally near Connaught Place in Delhi.
facts.quote: Dipke was granted conditional bail last month, a day after he was briefly detained and arrested for trying to take out a Tiranga rally near Connaught Place in Delhi.

ai.background_note: CJP has been protesting against SIR irregularities, which involve the Election Commission's house-to-house recheck of India's voter lists.
